name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-sync
description: Campaign Studio metrics-sync chain (RFC 0013; campaign gap plan C2 on ADR 0159). Pulls yesterday's ad metrics for every dispatched campaign through the acting user's platform connection (ctx.ads, window-scoped so rows never double-count) into the unified performance store, then delivers a short sync summary as a notification. Schedule it daily on the ONE scheduler, or run it ad hoc — the 15-minute cooldown makes overlapping fires harmless. Also carries the daily budget-pacing check (ADR 0220).
author: openwop

chains.label: Daily Ad-Metrics Sync
chains.description: Pull yesterday's spend/impressions/clicks for every dispatched campaign on one ad platform (meta or google) into the performance store — per-campaign best-effort, deduped, cooldown-guarded — and notify with the result. Pair with a daily schedule for hands-off freshness (feeds the KPI cards, budget recommendations, and the attribution join).

orgId.description: The org whose performance store receives the rows.

platform.description: The ad platform to pull (the two with live metrics readers).

chains.label: Daily Budget Pacing Check
chains.description: Compare every campaign's actual spend (performance store) against its budget plan and notify on band escalations (80% warning / 100% over) — once per escalation, never per run. Pair with a daily schedule after the metrics sync.

orgId.description: The org whose campaigns are paced.

alerted.description: Band escalations that raised a notification.
